title: Celesteria: Steamed
description: Celesteria: Steamed is a Minecraft modpack focused on engineering and creativity, built around the Create mod and Create Aeronautics. It lets players design automated machines, complex factories, and working aircraft in a physics-based sandbox.
body:
**Official Celesteria Modpack**

Celesteria: Steamed is an immersive, tech-focused Minecraft experience built around the innovative engineering systems of Create and Create Aeronautics. Designed for players who enjoy creativity, automation, and physics-driven contraptions, this modpack lets you build everything from intricate factories to fully functional flying machines.

Explore a world where engineering meets imagination—design complex mechanical systems, automate resource production, and take to the skies with customizable aircraft powered by advanced Create-based mechanics. Whether you’re constructing massive industrial networks or experimenting with aeronautical builds.

**This modpack is currently in Beta.**

We are actively improving performance, balancing gameplay, and adding new features. If you encounter any bugs or issues, please report them in our official Discord server to help us improve the experience for everyone.
